content: Round7 checking lesson: store the parameterization and normalization with every derivative. Nonstationary test points detect a missing mirror factor that every root-residual test misses. Fixed-space potential perturbations and variable-weight strings use different denominators. Full-interface Hessians require true matrix multiplication; away from stationarity retain the rank-one term. Local formal references: lean-proof/SL/AuditRound7.lean (mirrored_gap_from_single_interface, mirrored_stationarity_iff) checks scalar combination under explicit FH premises; see the round7 report for exact compiler and semantic receipts, not a full spectral differentiability theorem. The old op03_gap_precise eigenfunction backend has a confirmed propagator-order defect; current op03_gap_fh imports existing fixed and was checked on bounded examples. Historical callers and analytic spectral Jacobian backends are not globally certified by these finite tests.
